author: Awarrior
body:
Daily Building Tips!

Current Tips "Donators" x):  AwarriorVenom & KooDaLord

Entry #1: Explanations
Hello people of Avicus, im extremely proud to present you the new serie im gonna be starting with Koo!

The Daily Building Tips serie! 

Each and every single day we will post one tip on map making, can be from general structure, can be World Edit sneaky tips, can be anything map making related. Heres a few subjects possible.  

 (Fantasy, Medieval, Steampunk, Organics, World Edit, Voxel Sniper, MCEdit, World Painter, Realism, Modern, Elfic)

So basically everyday either me or Koo will post a tip over on map making, there will of course be some basic stuff, but don't "rage" about it.

Now the tips might have a video linked within if it is a complicated explanation. Meaning, some tips wont have their own video...

Me and Koo are doing this to help you avicus players create maps faster and much more effectively. 

So without further due, lets get this hopefully long run started!

- Awarrior (18th July, First Entry & Introduction to the thread) 

-------------------------------------------------------------

Tip #1: Rotating a quarter of a build to increase efficiency
Helps: Increasing efficiency 
Programs Needed: None
Plugins Needed: World Edit  
Commands Used: //rotate 90 , //paste , //copy , //wand , //pos1 & 2
Author: AwarriorVenom
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HWgA9j5fFsA&feature=youtu.be
Peek:
-------------------------------------------------------------
Tip #2: Building Medieval Themed houses
Helps: Starting to outline a medieval themed build / detailling
Programs Needed: None
Plugins Needed: World Edit
Commands Used: //copy, //paste ~~
Author: KooDaLord
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=angPYsPhhiE&feature=youtu.be
Peek:  Koo is gonna work on this build exclusively, he will maintain this as a "Serie" Building a Medieval House with Koo, :D
-------------------------------------------------------------
Tip #3: Percentages 
Helps: Detailling maps
Programs Needed: None
Plugins Needed: World Edit
Commands Used: //replace , //POS1 , //POS2
Author: AwarriorVenom
Video: None Needed
Peek: None Needed
Description: You can use percentages for anything in world edit as long as the total is 100%
Heres an example: //replace stone 50%cobble,50%stone
THE COMA IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT! 
MAKE SURE ITS 100% THE TOTAL
-------------------------------------------------------------
Tip #4: Type of logs
Helps: Detailling maps
Programs Needed: None
Plugins Needed: World Edit
Commands Used: //replace , //POS1 , //POS2, //replacenear 
Author: AwarriorVenom
Video: None Needed
Peek: Heres after and before the "treatment"

Description: You can build any tree with any type of wood, and replace it's logs using either  //replace tree log:12  (TREE STANDS FOR THE LOGS meaning the leaves aren't included)    //replacenear 20 tree log:12. Starts at log:12 It goes up to log:15 
-------------------------------------------------------------
Tip #5: Type of special blocks
Helps: Detailling maps
Programs Needed: None
Plugins Needed: World Edit
Commands Used: //replace , //POS1 , //POS2, //replacenear 
Author: AwarriorVenom
Video: None Needed
Peek: Those blocks can be used for building in this way

Description: Those blocks can be used for building special structures, and they add a little bit of niceness to your builds ^-^ Especially the sandstone one for the terrain, and the 43:8 for detailling

43:12000 makes it easier to place down double slabs,
43:8 makes bootiful details
44:9 makes bootiful terrain

You can build with any of these blocks!
-------------------------------------------------------------
Tip #6: Copy and pasting tutorial
Helps: Increasing speed while building
Programs Needed: None
Plugins Needed: World Edit
Commands Used: //POS1 , //POS2, //copy, //paste, //rotate (90 , 180, 270 ,360)
Author: AwarriorVenom
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-ZIhysk_ORw&feature=youtu.be
Peek: 

Description: None Needed
-------------------------------------------------------------
Tip #7: Volcano Tutorial!
Helps: Landscaping
Programs Needed: None
Plugins Needed: World Edit
Commands Used: //POS1 , //POS2, //copy, //paste, //rotate (90 , 180, 270 ,360), //naturalize, //replace, //overlay
Author: AwarriorVenom
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YesKydvAMns
Peek:

Description: None Needed
